questions: Please provide the current released mechanical drawings and dimensional/coplanarity/bend tolerances. We need maximum installed top height and minimum underside clearance, including specified seating and solder thickness, not tape/reel cavity dimensions.

Please confirm MJP-0.7-T is phosphor bronze and MJP-1.0-T is copper, the exact alloy/conductivity or DC resistance limit, and equivalence between bulk and reel parts. A distributor's MJP-1.0-T metadata lists bronze, unlike the catalog.

For the 20A catalog rating, what are the ambient, temperature rise, cooling, duty, PCB copper/lands, solder alloy and test fixture? Is there a derating curve or application guidance for 12A continuously in an enclosed stack with our retained 1.25 conductor-sizing margin?

Please provide contact/solder-joint resistance or applicable limits, recommended land dimensions beyond the 2mm minimum, paste/stencil and reflow guidance, and relevant thermal-cycling qualification. Enlarged 3.5mm copper lands with separately designed paste are being considered, not yet qualified.

Please quote traceable samples or cut tape and full reels separately, with lead time, destination/assembler delivery options, and feeder leader/trailer requirements. This is a technical/quotation request only, not a purchase order.

questions: Can you accept the exact MJP-0.7-T (32mm tape, 700/reel) and/or MJP-1.0-T (44mm tape, 700/reel)? Is either already available through your supported native/consignment inventory?

Confirm feeder/nozzle, placement accuracy, paste/stencil, reflow compatibility, solder fillet/void acceptance and inspection for this formed metal conductor. Do your assembly constraints permit enlarged copper lands and a separately specified paste pattern?

What installed maximum top height, minimum underside clearance, seating/coplanarity and board-bow limits can be guaranteed for this exact process? Nominal-only placement is insufficient to guarantee unchanged assembly height.

If an underside placement is proposed, can it be attached and inspected without disturbing the existing top-side SMT/THT assembly? State any new setup, retention, selective/manual solder or inspection requirements; this alternative has not been selected.

For a comparison of 100 boards with one bar each, quote setup, per-part placement, required overage, consignment/handling/customs, inspection and unused inventory terms separately. Clarify the applicable overseas fee schedule rather than combining generic website figures. Please also quote the sample/prototype minimum. No order or shipment is authorized.
